x: User-assigned identities are real ARM resources (create/get/list/delete) with a minted principalId/clientId/tenantId. Attaching one to any resource (identity.type UserAssigned / SystemAssigned,UserAssigned with identity.userAssignedIdentities) is validated (an unknown identity is rejected 400 ResourceNotFound) and the referenced identity's principalId/clientId are resolved into the resource's identity block; the principalId is a valid subject for role assignments.
